stem: The little girl was deeply ____ (move) by the story her grandmother told her.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作表语。修饰人（女孩）的内心感受，用过去分词 moved，意为"被感动"。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作表语

stem: The bridge ____ (build) last year connects the two towns.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作后置定语。bridge 与 build 是被动关系，且动作已完成，用过去分词 built。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作定语

stem: He ____ (see) a movie with his friends yesterday evening.
explanation: 考查谓语动词时态。由 yesterday evening 可知用一般过去时，see 的过去式为 saw。

stem: It is a great honor for me to be invited to such ____ important meeting.
explanation: 考查冠词。meeting 为可数名词单数，important 以元音音素开头，用不定冠词 an。

stem: The house, ____ roof was damaged in the storm, has been repaired.
explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词 house 与 roof 存在所属关系，用关系代词 whose。

stem: My brother is determined ____ (finish) the task before Friday.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。固定搭配 be determined to do sth.，用不定式 to finish。

stem: She succeeded ____ passing the driving test on her first try.
explanation: 考查介词固定搭配。succeed in doing sth. 意为"成功做某事"。

stem: There are many ____ (member) in this club.
explanation: 考查名词复数。由 many 可知用复数形式 members。

stem: I told ____ (I) that I must study harder.
explanation: 考查反身代词。主语 I 与宾语指同一人，用反身代词 myself。

stem: The students are ____ (excite) about the coming sports meeting.
explanation: 考查分词形容词。修饰人（students）的内心感受用 excited；exciting 修饰事物。

stem: The novel is so interesting that it is worth ____ a second time.
explanation: 考查固定搭配 be worth doing，用主动形式表被动含义，故选 reading。

stem: The teacher, together with his students, ____ going to visit the museum tomorrow.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。together with 后接成分不影响谓语单复数，主语是 the teacher（单数），且 tomorrow 表将来，用 is going to。

stem: The doctor suggested that he ____ more exercise to improve his health.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。suggest 表"建议"时，宾语从句用 (should) + 动词原形，should 可省略，故选 take。

stem: It was not until midnight ____ they reached the campsite.
explanation: 考查强调句型 It was + 被强调部分 + that。强调时间状语 not until midnight，用 that。

stem: I don't know the meaning of this word. I need to ____ it in the dictionary.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。look up 意为"查阅"，符合"查字典"语境。

stem: The old man lives alone, but he doesn't feel ____ because he has many friends.
explanation: 考查近义词辨析。alone 强调客观"独自"，lonely 强调主观"孤独"。句意转折，选 lonely。

stem: We should make full use of our time to study, because time ____ will never return.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作定语。time 与 lose 是被动关系，用过去分词 lost 作后置定语，意为"逝去的时间"。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作定语

stem: She has a gift for music and she dreams of becoming a famous ____.
explanation: 考查词义辨析。由"音乐天赋"可推知梦想成为音乐家 musician。

stem: She is always complaining about something. She has become a real ____.
explanation: 考查词义辨析。由"总在抱怨"可推知她成了令人讨厌的人，nuisance 意为"讨厌的人/事"。

stem: ____ the bad weather, they still went to school on time.
explanation: 考查介词辨析。句意表转折"尽管天气不好，仍按时上学"，Despite 意为"尽管"，后接名词短语。

stem: Not only the students but also the teacher ____ fond of playing basketball.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。not only...but also... 连接并列主语时遵循就近原则，与 the teacher（单数）一致，用 is。

stem: By the time you get back, I ____ all the housework.
explanation: 考查时态。by the time 引导时间状语从句表将来完成，主句用将来完成时 will have finished。

stem: The reason ____ he was late was that he missed the early bus.
explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词 reason 在从句中作原因状语，用关系副词 why 引导。

stem: Hardly had he arrived at the station ____ the train left.
explanation: 考查固定结构 hardly...when...，意为"一……就……"，hardly 位于句首时主句部分倒装。

stem: The manager, as well as his assistants, ____ to attend the meeting.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。as well as 连接并列主语时谓语与前面的主语 the manager 一致，用单数 is。

stem: I would rather you ____ here with me now.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。would rather 后接从句表对现在/将来的虚拟，用一般过去时 stayed。

stem: This is the most interesting book ____ I have ever read.
explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词被最高级修饰时，关系代词只能用 that。

stem: The population of China is larger than ____ of any other country in the world.
explanation: 考查代词。用 that 指代前文的 the population（单数不可数名词），避免重复。

stem: ____ is known to all, the earth moves around the sun.
explanation: 考查非限制性定语从句。As is known to all 为固定结构，as 指代整个主句。

stem: He was about to go out ____ it began to rain.
explanation: 考查固定结构 be about to do...when...，意为"正要做某事，这时……"，when 表"这时"。

stem: When the boy found his lost dog, he was so excited that he couldn't ____ his tears.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。hold back 意为"抑制、控制（情感/眼泪）"，符合语境。

stem: The little girl was afraid of the dark, so she always slept with the light ____ on.
explanation: 考查 with 复合结构。light 与 turn on 是被动关系，用过去分词 turned 作宾语补足语。

stem: To our great ____, the project was completed ahead of schedule.
explanation: 考查固定搭配 to one's surprise，意为"令某人惊讶的是"，名词用原形。

stem: He ____ me of his decision to quit the job last week.
explanation: 考查动词搭配。inform sb. of sth. 意为"通知某人某事"，符合语境。

stem: The two brothers look so ____ that many people mistake one for the other.
explanation: 考查近义词辨析。alike 只作表语，意为"相像的"；similar 需接 to；same 需接 the。look alike 符合语境。

stem: ____ I get the money, I will pay you back immediately.
explanation: 考查连词辨析。as soon as 意为"一……就……"，符合"一拿到钱就还"的语境。

stem: It was not until the rain stopped ____ the match continued.
explanation: 考查强调句型 It was not until...that...，强调时间状语从句，用 that。

stem: His new book has attracted the ____ of many young readers.
explanation: 考查名词辨析。attract one's attention 意为"吸引某人的注意"，符合语境。

stem: She was the only one who ____ the terrible accident.
explanation: 考查动词辨析。survive 意为"幸存"，是及物动词，符合"从事故中幸存"的语境。

stem: The more you practice, the ____ you will become at speaking English.
explanation: 考查"the+比较级, the+比较级"结构。fluent 为双音节词，比较级用 more fluent。

stem: ____ his old age, he still works in the garden every day.
explanation: 考查介词短语辨析。in spite of 意为"尽管"，表让步，符合"尽管年迈仍劳作"的语境。

stem: It is important that every student ____ the school rules.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。It is important that... 句型中，从句用 (should) + 动词原形，故用 observe。

stem: The manager was satisfied with the work the new clerk had ____.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。carry out 意为"执行、完成"，符合"完成工作"的语境。

stem: Nobody can tell exactly when the custom first came into ____.
explanation: 考查固定搭配。come into being 意为"形成、产生"，符合语境。

stem: ____ in the queue for half an hour, the old man suddenly realized he had left his wallet at home.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。wait 的动作先于 realize 发生，用现在分词完成式 Having waited。

stem: The government has taken measures to ____ the environment from pollution.
explanation: 考查动词辨析。protect...from... 意为"保护……免受……"，符合语境。

stem: I can't ____ the difference between the two words.
explanation: 考查动词辨析。tell the difference between 为固定搭配，意为"分辨……的差别"。

stem: The ____ of the fire is still unknown.
explanation: 考查名词辨析。cause 指导致某事发生的直接原因；reason 指做某事的理由。火灾的"起因"用 cause。

stem: You'd better take an umbrella ____ it rains.
explanation: 考查连词辨析。in case 意为"以防、万一"，符合"带伞以防下雨"的语境。

stem: His speech made a deep ____ on all the listeners.
explanation: 考查名词搭配。make a deep impression on 意为"给……留下深刻印象"。

stem: The weather here is ____ from that in my hometown.
explanation: 考查形容词辨析与搭配。be different from 意为"与……不同"。

stem: He is ____ to his job and works until late at night.
explanation: 考查形容词搭配。be devoted to 意为"专心于、献身于"，符合语境。

stem: The meeting has been ____ off until next Monday.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。put off 意为"推迟"，符合语境。

stem: ____ of the students in our class passed the exam.
explanation: 考查分数表达。三分之二用 two thirds，分子大于 1 时分母加 s。

stem: The doctor advised him to give up ____.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。give up 后接动名词 smoking，意为"戒烟"。

stem: The two brothers are so ____ in appearance that I can hardly tell them apart.
explanation: 考查近义词辨析。identical 意为"完全相同的"，程度比 similar 更深，符合"几乎分不出"的语境；same 需搭配 the。

stem: We should ____ every opportunity to learn English well.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。make use of 意为"利用"，符合"利用每个机会"的语境。

stem: The committee ____ of twelve members from different departments.
explanation: 考查动词辨析与搭配。consist of 意为"由……组成"，无被动语态；be composed of 也表"组成"但需被动，故选 consists。

stem: It is ____ to learn English well if you keep practicing every day.
explanation: 考查句型与形容词辨析。It is possible to do sth. 为固定句型；probable/likely 不用于此结构。

stem: The new policy will come into ____ next month.
explanation: 考查易混词辨析。come into effect 意为"生效"；注意 affect 是动词"影响"，effort 是"努力"。

stem: By the time the teacher arrived, the students ____ (clean) the classroom.
explanation: 考查时态。by the time 引导过去时间，主句动作先于从句，用过去完成时 had cleaned。

stem: The windows ____ (wash) by Tom every Sunday.
explanation: 考查被动语态。windows 与 wash 是被动关系，every Sunday 表一般现在时，用 are washed。

stem: She is one of the girls who ____ (be) good at singing.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。定语从句先行词是 the girls（复数），关系代词 who 指代 girls，故用 are。

stem: ____ (give) more time, we could have finished the work better.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作条件状语。we 与 give 是被动关系，用过去分词 Given。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作状语

stem: He suggested that the meeting ____ (put) off until next week.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气与被动。suggest 表建议时从句用 (should)+动词原形，meeting 与 put off 被动，故 be put。

stem: This is the third time that I ____ (visit) the Great Wall.
explanation: 考查时态。It/This is the first/second/... time that... 句型中，从句用现在完成时。

stem: The book ____ (write) in 1990 is still popular today.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作定语。book 与 write 是被动关系，用过去分词 written 作后置定语。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作定语

stem: Not only ____ (he, like) music, but he also enjoys painting.
explanation: 考查倒装。not only 位于句首，主句部分倒装，一般现在时用 does he like。

stem: He would rather stay at home than ____ (go) out in such bad weather.
explanation: 考查固定结构 would rather do than do，than 后接动词原形 go。

stem: The news that he told us ____ (make) everyone happy.
explanation: 考查时态与主谓一致。news 为不可数名词作主语，用单数；语境为过去，用 made。

stem: ____ (face) with so many difficulties, we must stay calm.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。be faced with 为固定搭配，作状语时省略 be，用 Faced。

stem: It is high time that we ____ (take) action to protect the environment.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。It is (high) time that... 句型中，从句用一般过去时表虚拟，用 took。
knowledge_point: 虚拟语气-It is time that

stem: The harder you work, the ____ (great) progress you will make.
explanation: 考查比较级。the+比较级, the+比较级 结构，great 的比较级为 greater。

stem: He spoke ____ (loud) that everyone in the hall could hear him.
explanation: 考查 so...that... 结构与副词。修饰动词 spoke 用副词 loudly，so loudly that 表结果。

stem: Either you or he ____ (be) going to be responsible for the accident.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。either...or... 遵循就近原则，与 he（单数）一致，用 is。

stem: The number of students in our school ____ (be) increasing year by year.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。the number of 后接名词作主语，谓语用单数 is。

stem: It was in the library ____ I met my old friend yesterday.
explanation: 考查强调句型。It was + 被强调部分（地点状语）+ that，用 that。

stem: The children are looking forward to ____ (hear) from their parents.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。look forward to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词 hearing。

stem: ____ (not, know) what to do, she turned to her teacher for help.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作原因状语。she 与 know 是主动关系，用现在分词，否定形式 Not knowing。

stem: No sooner had I sat down ____ the phone rang.
explanation: 考查固定结构 no sooner...than...，意为"一……就……"，no sooner 位于句首主句倒装。

stem: He is the only one of the students who ____ (have) passed the exam.
explanation: 考查主谓一致。先行词是 the only one，定语从句谓语用单数 has。

stem: ____ (compare) with last year, the price of rice has gone up a lot.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。price 与 compare 是被动关系，用过去分词 Compared。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作状语

stem: You can't imagine what great difficulty I had ____ (find) your house.
explanation: 考查固定结构 have difficulty (in) doing sth.，介词 in 省略，用动名词 finding。

stem: The teacher insisted that the student ____ (do) his homework himself.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。insist 表"坚持要求"时，宾语从句用 (should)+动词原形。

stem: Great changes ____ (take) place in my hometown in the past ten years.
explanation: 考查时态。in the past ten years 与现在完成时连用，changes 作主语，用 have taken。

stem: What he said at the meeting was ____ (great) importance.
explanation: 考查固定表达。be of + 抽象名词 = be + 形容词，be of great importance 意为"非常重要"。
knowledge_point: 固定结构-be of + 名词

stem: I'll never forget the day ____ we first met in the small village.
explanation: 考查定语从句。先行词 the day 在从句中作时间状语，用关系副词 when。

stem: She was praised for ____ (she) honesty and hard work.
explanation: 考查代词。修饰名词 honesty 用形容词性物主代词 her。

stem: The more careful you are, the ____ (few) mistakes you will make.
explanation: 考查比较级。mistakes 为可数名词，few 的比较级为 fewer。

stem: ____ (see) from the top of the hill, the city looks very beautiful.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。city 与 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-过去分词作状语

stem: Only in this way ____ (can, you) solve the problem.
explanation: 考查倒装。only + 状语 位于句首，主句部分倒装，用 can you。

stem: The boy stood there, ____ (tremble) with cold.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作伴随状语。boy 与 tremble 是主动关系，用现在分词 trembling。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-现在分词作状语

stem: I regret ____ (tell) you that you have failed the exam.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。regret to do 意为"遗憾地要做某事"，regret doing 意为"后悔做过"，此处选 to tell。

stem: It was not long ____ he realized that he had made a mistake.
explanation: 考查固定结构 It was not long before... 意为"不久就……"。

stem: The music sounds ____ (beauty), and we all enjoy it.
explanation: 考查形容词作表语。sound 为系动词，后接形容词 beautiful，不用副词。

stem: My teacher advised that I ____ (read) more English books.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。advise 表建议时，宾语从句用 (should)+动词原形。

stem: He asked me ____ I had finished my homework.
explanation: 考查宾语从句。ask 后的宾语从句表"是否"，用 whether 或 if。

stem: We found the little boy ____ (lie) on the ground.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作宾补。boy 与 lie 是主动关系且动作正在进行，用现在分词 lying。
knowledge_point: 非谓语动词-现在分词作宾补

stem: ____ is known to everybody, practice makes perfect.
explanation: 考查定语从句。As is known to everybody 为固定结构，as 指代整个主句。

stem: The plan requires that we ____ (work) together closely.
explanation: 考查虚拟语气。require 后接宾语从句用 (should)+动词原形。

stem: The poor old man had no choice but ____ for help from passers-by.
explanation: 考查固定结构 have no choice but to do sth.，but 前有实义动词，后接带 to 的不定式。

stem: She devoted all her spare time ____ English literature.
explanation: 考查固定搭配 devote...to...，to 是介词，后接动名词 studying。

stem: ____ the heavy rain, the sports meeting was put off.
explanation: 考查介词短语辨析。due to 意为"由于"，后接名词短语，表原因。

stem: He was late again, which made his teacher very ____.
explanation: 考查形容词作宾补。make sb.+形容词，用 angry 作 his teacher 的补足语。

stem: It's no use ____ over spilt milk.
explanation: 考查固定句型 It's no use doing sth.，用动名词 crying。

stem: The boy pretended ____ when his mother came in.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词。pretend to do 表"假装做"；"妈妈进来时"强调正在进行，用 to be sleeping。

stem: I'm looking forward to ____ from you soon.
explanation: 考查固定搭配 look forward to doing，to 是介词，用动名词 hearing。

stem: The teacher told us that light ____ faster than sound.
explanation: 考查时态。宾语从句描述客观真理，用一般现在时 travels。

stem: You'd better have your bad tooth ____ at once.
explanation: 考查 have sth. done 结构。tooth 与 pull out 是被动关系，用过去分词 pulled out。

stem: ____ it or not, the little girl can speak three languages.
explanation: 考查固定结构 believe it or not，意为"信不信由你"。

stem: He is too young to ____ such a difficult problem.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。work out 意为"解决、算出"，符合"解决难题"的语境。

stem: The two friends haven't seen each other for years, but they still keep in ____.
explanation: 考查固定搭配 keep in touch，意为"保持联系"。

stem: ____ from the moon, the earth looks like a blue ball.
explanation: 考查非谓语动词作状语。earth 与 see 是被动关系，用过去分词 Seen。

stem: I have no idea ____ he will come or not.
explanation: 考查同位语从句。or not 前只能用 whether，不能用 if。

stem: The accident ____ because the driver was too careless.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。come about 意为"发生"，符合"事故的发生"语境。

stem: He found it hard to ____ the changes in his new school.
explanation: 考查动词短语辨析。adapt to 意为"适应"，符合"适应变化"的语境。

stem: ____ your help, we couldn't have finished the work on time.
explanation: 考查介词短语辨析。but for 意为"要不是"，常与虚拟语气连用，符合语境。

stem: The boss made the workers ____ ten hours a day.
explanation: 考查 make sb. do sth. 结构，make 后接不带 to 的不定式作宾补。

stem: We must take ____ to prevent the river from being polluted.
explanation: 考查固定搭配 take measures to do sth.，意为"采取措施做某事"。

stem: The problem is ____ we can get enough money for the project.
explanation: 考查表语从句。句意表"问题在于是否能筹到钱"，用 whether 表"是否"。

stem: She was so tired that she couldn't help ____ asleep during class.
explanation: 考查固定结构 can't help doing，意为"忍不住做某事"。

stem: ____ the teacher's help, we made great progress.
explanation: 考查介词搭配。with one's help 意为"在某人的帮助下"。

stem: I would appreciate it if you could ____ my letter at your earliest convenience.
explanation: 考查动词搭配。reply to + 宾语，意为"回复（信/问题）"；reply 是不及物动词，需加 to。

stem: The number of people invited ____ fifty, but a number of them ____ absent.

stem: 句子 "He suggested to take a taxi to the airport." 语法正确。
explanation: suggest 后接动名词，应改为 He suggested taking a taxi。

stem: 句子 "Neither he nor his friends was late for school." 语法正确。
explanation: neither...nor... 遵循就近原则，与 his friends（复数）一致，应用 were。

stem: 句子 "If I had known your address, I would have visited you." 语法正确。
explanation: 对过去情况的虚拟，从句用 had done，主句用 would have done，用法正确。

stem: 句子 "The teacher made the naughty boy to stand outside." 语法正确。
explanation: make sb. do sth. 中宾补用不带 to 的不定式，应去掉 to。

stem: 句子 "She has gone to Beijing three times." 语法正确。
explanation: has gone to 表"去了还没回来"，不能与次数连用；应改为 has been to。

stem: 句子 "The meeting will hold next Monday." 语法正确。
explanation: meeting 与 hold 是被动关系，应用被动语态 will be held。

stem: 句子 "He is used to get up early every morning." 语法正确。
explanation: be used to 中 to 是介词，后接动名词，应改为 getting up。
knowledge_point: 固定结构-be used to doing

stem: 句子 "It was in the park where I lost my wallet." 语法正确。
explanation: 强调句型应用 that，不用 where，应改为 It was in the park that...

stem: 句子 "No matter what happens, I will support you." 语法正确。
explanation: no matter what 引导让步状语从句，用法正确。

stem: 句子 "The number of the students are increasing." 语法正确。
explanation: the number of 后接名词作主语时谓语用单数，应改为 is。

stem: 句子 "Hardly had he entered the room when the phone rang." 语法正确。
explanation: hardly...when... 结构，hardly 位于句首主句倒装，用法正确。

stem: 句子 "I have two sisters, both of whom are teachers." 语法正确。
explanation: both of whom 引导非限制性定语从句，指代人用 whom，用法正确。
knowledge_point: 定语从句-介词+关系代词

stem: 句子 "She insisted that she was right and would not give in." 语法正确。
explanation: insist 表"坚持认为"时，宾语从句用陈述语气，用法正确。

stem: 句子 "The reason why he was late was because he missed the bus." 语法正确。
explanation: the reason...was 后应接 that，不能用 because，应改为 was that。

stem: 句子 "Reading is as important as writing." 语法正确。
explanation: as...as... 同级比较结构，用法正确。

stem: 句子 "He is the tallest of the two boys." 语法正确。
explanation: 两者比较用比较级，应改为 the taller of the two boys。

stem: 句子 "I would rather to stay at home than go out." 语法正确。
explanation: would rather 后接动词原形，应去掉 to。

stem: 句子 "The news are exciting." 语法正确。
explanation: news 是不可数名词，谓语用单数 is。

stem: 句子 "It is no good to worry about the result." 语法正确。
explanation: It is no good 后接动名词，应改为 worrying about。
knowledge_point: 固定结构-It is no good doing

stem: 句子 "Only after he finished the work did he go home." 语法正确。

stem: 句子 "She is the girl whom I think is the best student." 语法正确。
explanation: 关系代词在从句中作主语，应用 who，不能用 whom。
knowledge_point: 定语从句-关系代词作主语

stem: 句子 "There is a lot of people in the hall." 语法正确。

Notice

stem: 假定你是李华，请给外教 Mr. Smith 写一封邀请信，邀请他参加你校本周六下午在图书馆举行的英语角活动。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear Mr. Smith,
I'm writing to invite you to our English Corner, which will be held in the school library at 3 p.m. this Saturday. The topic is "My Favorite Book". It would be a great honor if you could come and share your ideas with us. I'm sure your joining will make the activity more interesting. Looking forward to your early reply.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
explanation: 邀请信需含写信目的、活动时间地点、邀请内容、期待回复，语气礼貌得体。

stem: 假定你是李华，你的朋友王明写信向你请教学习英语的方法，请给他写一封建议信。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear Wang Ming,
I'm glad to hear from you. Here are some suggestions on learning English. First, read English aloud every day to improve your pronunciation. Second, listen to English songs or news to train your listening. Third, don't be afraid of making mistakes and try to speak more. I hope my advice will be helpful to you. Best wishes!
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 建议信需包含开场、若干条具体建议（可用 First/Second/Third 分层）和结尾祝福。

stem: 假定你是李华，因生病未能按时参加与朋友 Tom 约定的见面，请给他写一封道歉信。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear Tom,
I'm terribly sorry that I failed to meet you yesterday. I caught a bad cold and had to stay in bed all day, so I couldn't go out. I hope you can forgive me. Would it be possible for us to meet again this Sunday afternoon? Please let me know if it is convenient for you. Once again, I'm sorry for the trouble.
Yours,
Li Hua
explanation: 道歉信需表达歉意、解释原因、提出补救办法并再次致歉，语气诚恳。

stem: 假定你是李华，你的朋友 Jack 在你生病期间帮助了你，请给他写一封感谢信。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear Jack,
I'm writing to express my heartfelt thanks for your help during my illness. You not only sent me to the hospital but also helped me with my lessons. Without your help, I would have fallen far behind. I'm so lucky to have a friend like you. I hope I can do something for you in return some day.
Yours sincerely,
Li Hua
explanation: 感谢信需表达感谢、说明被感谢的具体事情及其影响，结尾可表达回报意愿。

stem: 假定你是李华，学校正在招募志愿者帮助社区老人，请写一封申请信。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I'm writing to apply for the position of a volunteer to help the elderly in our community. I'm warm-hearted and good at communicating with old people. Besides, I'm free on weekends. I believe I'm fit for the job and will do my best to help. I would be grateful if you could give me the chance.
Yours faithfully,
Li Hua
explanation: 申请信需表明申请意向、说明自身优势与条件、表达期望，格式规范。

stem: 假定你是李华，想了解某英语培训机构的课程，请写一封电子邮件询问课程安排、费用等信息。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear Sir or Madam,
I'm writing to ask for some information about your English courses. Could you tell me when the courses begin and how long they last? I'd also like to know how much the courses cost and whether there is a discount for students. I would appreciate it if you could reply as soon as possible.
Yours faithfully,
Li Hua
explanation: 咨询邮件需说明写信目的、提出具体问题（时间、时长、费用等），语气礼貌。

stem: 假定你是李华，要外出办事，请给室友写一张英文便条，请其帮忙转告电话内容或代收快递。词数约 60。
answer:
Dear Wang,
I have to go out on business this afternoon. Could you please answer the phone for me? If someone calls, please write down the message. Also, my package may arrive today, so please help me sign for it. Thank you very much.
Li Hua
explanation: 便条需简洁说明委托事项（接电话、记留言、收快递）并表达感谢，语言简短。

stem: 假定你在班级活动中要发表一段关于环保的英文演讲，请写一篇简短演讲稿，呼吁同学们从小事做起保护环境。词数约 100。
answer:
Dear classmates,
Today I want to talk about protecting the environment. Our earth is facing serious problems, such as pollution and the waste of resources. As students, we can do small things every day: turn off the lights, save water and recycle paper. If everyone does a little, we can make a big difference. Let's act now for a greener future. Thank you!
explanation: 演讲稿需有称呼、开场、主体（问题+行动呼吁）和致谢，语言有号召力。

stem: 假定你是李华，请用英语向外国朋友介绍你的家乡，包括位置、风景、特产等。词数约 100。
answer: My hometown is a beautiful city in Guangdong Province. It is famous for its pleasant weather and delicious food. There are many parks and rivers where people can relax. The most famous local food is rice noodles, which attracts visitors from all over the country. I love my hometown and I'm proud of it. Welcome to visit my hometown!
explanation: 介绍类写作需涵盖位置、风景、特产等要点，条理清晰，语言通顺。
